'''Dellocon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Darth Baras]] eventually had his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] kill him on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], as his true allegiance was in danger of being exposed.<ref name="start">{{TORcite|type=general|Seek Your Contact|the Sith Warrior's personal starship}}</ref>

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], [[Imperial Agent|Agent]] Dellocon was one of the many spies within [[Darth Baras]]' intelligence network. He was active on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when Baras sent [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to eliminate him, as he was in danger of being exposed due to the abilities of a [[Jaesa Willsaam|mysterious jedi padawan]].<ref name="start" /> Suspecting his impending doom, Dellocon sought Baras' rival, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Rathari]], offering his knowledge for protection. Despite being initially well protected and hidden, Dellocon met his fate as Baras' apprentice was able to track him down and have him [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="death">{{TORcite|type=general|To Kill a Sith Lord|Nar Shaddaa}}''</ref>.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Baras is insane and paranoid! I was a faithful servant, and my cover was intact! Do you expect me to accept being murdered just for reassurance? Just wait for death?|Dellocon, to [[Darth Baras|Baras']] [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]]|<ref name="death" />}}
Dellocon was supposedly a loyal and efficient agent, though virtually nothing is known about his time as one of Baras' spies. His defection and alliance to Baras' rival Rathari seemed to be mostly due to his former master's ruthless decision to have him eliminated.<ref name="death" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dellocon appears as a NPC during the [[Sith Warrior]] storyline in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Although he makes only a brief appearance during the last mission on Nar Shaddaa, he's a relevant character to the plot, being the target of the manhunt that eventually puts the player against heavy resistance by many different groups of opponents throughout the planet.
